visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and silver necklace, stands in a kitchen setting with green cabinets. He holds several cloves of garlic in his hand, gesturing toward a blue and clear plastic kitchen appliance on the counter. (2) The camera zooms in on the clear bowl of the appliance. A hand drops the unpeeled garlic cloves into the bowl where a metal blade assembly is visible. (3) The appliance lid is closed, and the man presses down on the top. The garlic cloves spin rapidly inside, and white papery skins are seen separating from the cloves and flying around the container. (4) The lid is removed, revealing clean, yellow-white peeled garlic cloves. The man uses a silver spoon to scoop them out, showing a look of genuine surprise and delight on his face. (5) Transitioning to a second experiment, the man holds a white bowl filled with many small, dark purple grapes. He smiles and prepares to pour them into the same appliance. (6) The grapes are poured into the clear bowl. The man closes the lid and activates the machine again. (7) The grapes are seen being rapidly crushed and pulverized. The purple skins are shredded, and a dark purple liquid begins to fill the bottom of the container. (8) The man pours the thick purple liquid into a clear glass. He takes a sip and laughs heartily toward the camera, standing in the same kitchen environment with bright indoor lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with a rising pitch contour. Upbeat, fast-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 synthesized beat is layered underneath. (2) A sharp rattling sound of hard cloves hitting a plastic bowl occurs. The male voice remains loud and excited, maintaining high speech density. (3) A distinct high-frequency mechanical whirring sound starts, accompanied by the percussive sound of objects spinning inside a container. The narrator's pitch becomes even higher and more varied. (4) Mechanical whir stops abruptly. A metallic 'clink' of a spoon against plastic is heard. The narrator's tone becomes humorous and satisfied. (5) Soft thudding sounds of many small fruits being poured are heard. BGM continues at a steady volume. (6) A second whirring sound begins, this time wetter and more squelching in texture as objects are crushed. (7) Narrator exclaims loudly with high arousal and a wide pitch range. The sound of liquid pouring into a glass follows, ending with the sound of hearty human laughter over the final BGM bars.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence (Part 1) -> Evidence (Part 2) -> Unexpected Twist -> Humorous CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a humorous and engaging demonstration of a kitchen gadget, specifically a garlic peeler. It uses a dual-part narrative structure: first proving the efficacy of the tool with garlic (the intended use), and then subverting expectations by using it on grapes, which results in juice rather than peeled fruit. This 'failed' second experiment is framed as a comedic 'no waste' moment, designed to maximize viewer engagement and entertainment value through high-energy presentation.
